scope: Expert Missions 16-17 reward and mechanics evidence reconciliation

records.title: In the Realm of the Gods: Vegeta
records.historical_timer: 5:00 reported by older independent guides; current-version universal timer not independently established in this evidence layer
records.mechanics: Historical sources report boss health regeneration behavior; exact current regeneration formula and trigger thresholds remain unresolved.
records.acquisition: Super Spirit Bomb is consistently identified with EM16. Exact reward-generation condition and numerical drop rate remain unresolved.

records.title: In the Realm of the Gods: Goku
records.historical_timer: 1:30 reported by historical community evidence, with approximately +20 seconds reported at health-depletion thresholds; exact current timer behavior not independently established here
records.mechanics: Historical community reports describe a short starting timer and additional time after specific health thresholds. Exact current trigger values remain unresolved.
records.acquisition: Spirit Sword is consistently identified with EM17. Historical player reports indicate the skill can require repeated clears, supporting an RNG/reward-pool interpretation, but no numerical drop rate is claimed.

evidence_reconciliation.EM16_reward_identity: Multiple current and historical references identify Super Spirit Bomb as the EM16 reward.
evidence_reconciliation.EM17_reward_identity: Multiple current and historical references identify Spirit Sword as the EM17 reward. Earlier wiki wording suggesting Spirit Sword / Spirit Bomb naming variation should not be retained as the canonical reward label.
evidence_reconciliation.rank_requirement: A historical player report associated a Z Rank clear with receiving Spirit Sword, but the same report presents the Z Rank requirement as a question. No verified Z Rank requirement is established here.
evidence_reconciliation.drop_rate: No numerical drop rate is established for either skill.
evidence_reconciliation.version_scope: Timer and regeneration values from older guides and forum reports are preserved as historical evidence rather than asserted as universal current-version mechanics.

important_nonclaims: Do not claim a Z Rank requirement for either skill without stronger evidence.
Do not publish historical timer values as guaranteed current-version values.
Do not invent numerical drop rates.
Do not treat community strategy advice as canonical mechanics.
Do not merge Spirit Sword with Spirit Bomb; they are separate skills and EM17 is the documented Spirit Sword source.
